full_judgment:
19. Moreover, it is a well-settled principle of law that either a necessary party or a proper party may be added in the suit. A necessary party is one in whose absence no effective decree can be passed. Whereas a proper party is one whose presence is not necessary for passing an effective decree. 

 20. In view of the provision of the Artha Rin Adalat Ain, 2003, as well as the provision of Order 1, rule 10(2) of the CPC, the petitioners are neither the necessary nor proper parties in the aforesaid Artha Rin Suit. Since the petitioners are not related to the loan in question, in the absence of them an effective decree can be passed in the aforesaid Artha Rin Suit.
